Name: Gilead, Son of Machir
Summary: Gilead, son of Machir son of Manasseh, gave his name to the land of Gilead east of the Jordan.
KeyStory: Gilead's descendants, including Zelophehad and his daughters, inherited the hills that still bear his name.
RelatedPeople: Machir, Son of Manasseh; Hepher, Son of Gilead; Zelophehad; Manasseh
LifeLesson: A name can become a place where generations live.
